uk.title: Public buying
uk.text: From January 2027, the reviewed social-value policy covers specified UK central-government tenders. Contract scope and transition rules matter.
uk.question: Aviation procurement · test the actual tender criteria before shaping a bid.
uk.counter: From 1 January 2027, PPN 026 covers specified central-government procurements of £1m or more, inclusive of VAT; framework and transition rules matter. Existing review cutoff: 2026-11-11. This is UK relevance of a wider theme, not global prevalence or verified company impact.
